subject_uz: Ferroqotishmalar ishlab chiqarish uchun 200 tonna elektrod massasi yetkazib berish

requirements.summary_uz: Elektrod massasi elektr o'tkazuvchan briketlangan material bo'lib, termoantratsit, koks va pekdan iborat.
requirements.summary_en: Electrode paste is an electrically conductive briquetted material of thermo-anthracite, coke and pitch.

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulot begona aralashmalar bilan ifloslanmagan bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The paste must not be contaminated with foreign impurities.
requirements.quote: Загрязнение электродной массы посторонними примесями не допускается

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulot shartnoma tuzilgan sanadan oldingi uch oydan avval ishlab chiqarilmagan bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The goods must have been made no earlier than three months before the contract date.
requirements.quote: Не ранее трех месяцев до даты заключения договора на поставку

requirements.summary_uz: Qadoqlash GOST 24717 yoki boshqa xalqaro standartlarga mos, big-bag qoplarda bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Packaging must follow GOST 24717 or other international standards, in big-bags.
requirements.quote: Упаковку производят в соответствии с ГОСТ 24717 и/или другими

requirements.summary_uz: Ta'minotchi taklif qilinayotgan mahsulot ishlatiladigan korxonalar ro'yxatini (referens-list) taqdim etishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The supplier must provide a reference list of enterprises that use the offered product.
requirements.quote: Поставщик должен предоставить референс лист предприятий,

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlab chiqaruvchini tasdiqlovchi litsenziya mavjudligi baholanadi va u mezonlarda muhim (kritik) deb belgilangan.
requirements.summary_en: A licence confirming the manufacturer is scored and marked as critical in the criteria.
requirements.quote: Наличие лицензии, подтверждающей производителя продукции производственно-технического назначения

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulot buyurtma olingan sanadan 50 kalendar kun ichida yetkazib beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Delivery is within 50 calendar days of receiving the order.
requirements.quote: Буюртма олинган санадан бошлаб 50 календарь куни

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib berish joyi: Bekobod, O'zmetkombinat, DAP shartlarida.
requirements.summary_en: Delivery place: Bekabad, Uzmetkombinat, on DAP terms.

requirements.summary_uz: To'lov yetkazib berish faktiga ko'ra, AQSh dollarida, 20 ish kuni ichida amalga oshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Payment is on delivery, in USD, within 20 working days.

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat muddati mahsulot yetkazilgan kundan kamida 12 oy.
requirements.summary_en: Warranty of at least 12 months from delivery.
requirements.quote: Не менее 12 месяцев со дня поставки товара

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik va malaka bosqichidan o'tgan eng past narx taklif qilgan ishtirokchi g'olib bo'ladi.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder with the lowest price who passes the qualification and technical stages wins.
requirements.quote: Участник с наименьшей ценой, который прошел квалификационный и технический отбор объявляется

flags.quote: Наличие лицензии, подтверждающей производителя продукции производственно-технического назначения
flags.explanation_uz: Bu mezon "kritik" deb belgilangan: ball olinmasa keyingi baholash o'tkazilmaydi. Litsenziya turi aniq ko'rsatilmagan, ishlab chiqaruvchi va ishtirokchi turli yuridik shaxs bo'lsa, shartnoma bo'lmasa atigi 2 ball, bo'lsa 6 ball beriladi. Shu sababli ishlab chiqaruvchining o'zi bo'lmagan ta'minotchilar chetlatilishi yoki ball yo'qotishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: This criterion is marked critical: scoring zero stops further evaluation. The type of licence is not named, and a supplier that is not the manufacturer gets only 2 points without a cooperation contract and 6 with one. Suppliers who are not the manufacturer could be shut out or lose points.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishlab chiqaruvchining sifat va muvofiqlik hujjatlari (sertifikat, pasport) yoki ishlab chiqaruvchi bilan shartnoma taqdim etilsa, to'liq ball beriladi; litsenziya talabi qaysi hujjatni nazarda tutishi aniq ko'rsatilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Full points if the manufacturer's quality and conformity documents (certificate, passport) or a contract with the manufacturer are provided; name the exact licence or document intended.

documents_needed_uz: Ishtirokchi va uning ta'sischilari haqida umumiy ma'lumot (1-shakl)
Yetkazib berish va to'lov shartlari haqida ma'lumot (5-shakl)
Soliq qarzi yo'qligi haqida soliq idorasi ma'lumotnomasi
Ish tajribasi, referens-list va buyurtmachilarning ijobiy fikrlari
Ishlab chiqaruvchining sifat nazorati tizimi hujjatlari
